title: fd_pixrecord
description: `fd_pixrecord` simplifies handling Gem’s `pix_record` for recording the current `gemwin` pixels to a movie file, with controls for starting and stopping, recording length, filename/path, and frame dimensions. Supplying a filename and path through the first inlet appends an index to each new recording to prevent overwriting, while a full path with extension through the second inlet overrides this safeguard and may overwrite the file.
